Two database cylinders overlap an open cloud outline. This can read as a unified cloud-storage diagram or a cloud enclosure with independently reusable database content.

## Visual draft

A broad cloud outline rises behind two overlapping database cylinders of different sizes. Each cylinder has an elliptical top and curved horizontal division, with the smaller cylinder positioned in front at the right.

## Open question

Should cloud storage remain a unified diagram, or should the cloud and database symbols be authored separately?

## 1. Open cloud outline (container)

A cloud enclosure has a tall rounded upper lobe and a smaller right lobe, with an open lower edge. Exclude the database cylinders.

## 2. Paired database cylinders (sub)

Two overlapping database cylinders have elliptical tops and curved horizontal division lines, with the smaller one in front at the right. Exclude the cloud.
